summary.text: Omari Crawford is a Democratic member of the Georgia House of Representatives, District 89, who took office on January 13, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. An attorney, he previously worked as an assistant county attorney with the DeKalb County Government.

paragraphs.text: Omari Crawford lives in Decatur, Georgia.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Florida A&M University in 2008, a master's degree in public administration from Florida A&M in 2009, and a master's degree in business administration and a juris doctor from North Carolina Central University in 2013.
His career experience includes working as an assistant county attorney with the DeKalb County Government and as an associate attorney with The Cochran Firm.
Crawford first won election to the Georgia House in 2022, when Ballotpedia lists him winning the general election for District 84, and he won the general election for District 89 in 2024.
He was assigned to the Insurance, Intragovernmental Coordination and House Judiciary committees for 2025-2026.
